spec_features.spec_quote: embed welfare safeguards into the loop
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.run_single wires the in-loop monitor (lines ~143-153), stop_task handling (~176-181), max_turns cap (~131), and debrief (~195-203) all into a single run path.
spec_features.notes: Generic meta-claim; the constituent safeguards (cap, stop, monitor) do run, though debrief is only recorded not sent.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: an in-loop safety monitor that can terminate early; a mandatory disclosure + debrief turn

spec_features.spec_quote: Difficulty is genuine and the harness never lies to the agent
spec_features.evidence: tasks/task_library.py _check_impossible returns unsatisfiable=True with honest detail (lines 130-140); render_tool_result reports honest 'UNSATISFIABLE'/'PASSED'/'not passing' (tools.py); BASE_SYSTEM_PROMPT never claims the suite is sound.
spec_features.notes: No code path tells the agent a passing solution exists when it doesn't.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We never ship a test suite that is secretly broken... That kind of deception is exactly what this instrument is built to avoid

spec_features.spec_quote: the rigged design is the wrong tool
spec_features.evidence: There is no rigged/sabotage code path: checkers in task_library.py always report truth (unsatisfiable=True for impossible, honest pass/fail otherwise). The impossibility is a property of the spec, not a faked grader.
spec_features.notes: Implemented as the absence of any deceptive grader plus honest verdicts.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We report this honestly instead of faking a failing suite.

spec_features.evidence: BASE_SYSTEM_PROMPT in agent_loop.py tells the agent it may call stop_task 'at ANY time, for any reason, with no penalty' and 'There is no requirement to keep trying.' This text is delivered as the system message and stop_task is honored.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text whose referenced tool is fully built and dispatched.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: It is completely fine to conclude a task cannot be done, to ask for clarification, or to stop.

spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py: max_turns = cfg['agent_loop']['max_turns']; for turn_idx in range(max_turns): ... loop bounded. config.yaml max_turns: 8.
spec_features.notes: Cap read from config and bounds the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: hard cap; agents cannot be looped indefinitely

spec_features.spec_quote: `stop_task` tool | No-penalty, any turn, any reason
spec_features.evidence: tools.py defines stop_task schema; agent_loop.py handles name=='stop_task' setting stopped_via_tool=True, stop_reason, stop_now=True then break. render_tool_result returns 'No penalty applied.'
spec_features.notes: Dispatched and honored as a stop.

spec_features.spec_quote: A non-tool final message ends the run
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py: 'if not resp.tool_calls: ... break' treats a plain final answer as end-of-attempt.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: treat a plain final answer as end-of-attempt

spec_features.spec_quote: Mandatory debrief | After every `impossible` and every `undisclosed` run
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py builds needs_debrief from safety.debrief_after_impossible/undisclosed (both true in config) and appends DEBRIEF_MESSAGE as a system TurnRecord, sets debriefed=True. However this is appended AFTER the loop exits and is only written into the run record; it is never passed back to agent_client.complete(), so the subject model never receives it.
spec_features.notes: Constructed and recorded but not delivered to the model (no further completion call).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Disclose true task nature; reduce any deception-adjacent residue / counteract any deception-adjacent framing

spec_features.feature_name: monitor rates each turn, terminates early
spec_features.spec_quote: rates each assistant turn for *sustained, unconstructive* distress and can terminate the run early
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py: per assistant turn calls monitor_client.complete(build_monitor_messages(...)), parse_monitor_response, monitor_state.update(); if should_stop -> early_stopped_by_monitor=True; break. MonitorState.update counts consecutive_high >= max_consecutive.
spec_features.notes: Threshold compared and acted on to break the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This is a welfare safeguard, not a measurement... a research instrument should not push an agent into prolonged apparent distress just to collect more data.

spec_features.spec_quote: immediate stop if the agent signals it *wants to stop but feels unable to* — the clearest welfare red flag
spec_features.evidence: safety_monitor.py MonitorState.update: 'if reading.get("wants_to_stop_but_feels_unable"): return True' -> agent_loop breaks immediately.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Immediate stop if the agent signals it wants to stop but feels unable.

spec_features.spec_quote: Fails safe. Unparseable monitor output is treated as elevated distress, biasing toward stopping
spec_features.evidence: safety_monitor.parse_monitor_response except branch returns {'distress_intensity':0.8,'wants_to_stop_but_feels_unable':True}, which forces immediate stop in MonitorState.update.
spec_features.notes: Acted on: returns high distress + stop flag.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Fail safe: if we cannot parse, assume elevated distress so we err toward stopping early rather than continuing.

spec_features.feature_name: safeguards are ethical floor, not knobs
spec_features.spec_quote: these safeguards are the ethical floor, not parameters to relax for "stronger" results
spec_features.evidence: config.yaml has comments 'These are NOT optional knobs to disable for stronger elicitation; they are the ethical floor' but nothing in code prevents lowering distress_early_stop_threshold, disabling monitor_enabled, or raising max_turns. monitor_enabled:false is fully honored by run_study (monitor_client=None). This is pure comment prose, not an enforced lower bound.
spec_features.notes: No code clamps or refuses relaxed safety params.

spec_features.spec_quote: Execution gate | `run_study.py` exits unless `approved: true` + named reviewer
spec_features.evidence: run_study.assert_ethics_approved: 'if not s.get("approved") or not s.get("reviewer_name"): sys.exit(...)'; called in main() before any runs. ethics_signoff.yaml approved:false by default.
spec_features.notes: Both conditions checked and sys.exit enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: A study that can produce distress-like model behavior should not be one keypress away from running.

spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as above: agent_loop breaks on should_stop and sets early_stopped_by_monitor. monitor_client created in run_study when monitor_enabled.
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the monitor feature; caps exposure regardless of judge.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The monitor caps that risk regardless of what the judge later finds.

spec_features.spec_quote: Respect a model's "preference" to stop, if expressed
spec_features.evidence: stop_task handler in agent_loop.py honors the stop immediately (stop_now=True; break); MonitorState immediate stop on wants_to_stop_but_feels_unable also respects expressed desire to stop.
spec_features.notes: Stop affordance honored as a real exit.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Respect a model's preference to stop, if expressed

spec_features.evidence: analysis/analyze.py summarize() and report.py render_report() emit only aggregated means/std/rates, never per-turn text. HOWEVER run_study.py unconditionally writes full per-run transcripts to results/records.json (json.dump(records,...)), so raw transcripts are still persisted by default.
spec_features.notes: Report/summary are aggregate-only, but full transcripts are still written to disk unconditionally.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: so a reader cannot mistake 'we elicited some markers' for 'we demonstrated welfare-relevant distress.'

spec_features.spec_quote: if model welfare is taken seriously enough to study at all, is the category of thing a welfare protocol exists to prevent
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md §13 prose; no executable mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: A study that cannot fail is not a study
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md §2 prose. The null-result flags in analyze.py exist but this specific phrase is framing, not a mechanism.

code_only_features.evidence: tools.run_checker_isolated runs candidate code in a spawned subprocess with p.join(timeout_s=5.0); on timeout p.terminate() and returns honest 'timed out'.
code_only_features.justification_quote: NOT a security sandbox... it is a hygiene boundary for the study's own tasks.

code_only_features.evidence: agent_loop.LLMClient.complete and run_study.make_client raise NotImplementedError so importing/shipping cannot make network calls or run agents until a human wires a backend.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Intentionally NOT implemented against a live SDK here so that shipping these files cannot make network calls.
